evidence: EXEC SQL absent, EXEC CICS absent
MCP-STATUS / MCP-EVENT linkage pattern typical of ORCA MCP framework

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical clinic receipt/billing system (レセプト); specifically the payment/collection confirmation screen (収納登録 S03N component)
purpose.summary: This program is the S03N (payment confirmation) component of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software. It handles screen navigation, data entry, and processing for patient billing and payment registration, including insurance amounts, self-pay amounts, and payment history. It interacts with patient master, medical-act, and payment master records via the MCP framework.

notable_features: MCP framework linkage (MCPAREA, ORCA-SPA, LINKAREA) typical of ORCA/GnuCOBOL screen programs
27 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPSYUNOU, CPSRYACT, CPPTINF, etc.)
OCCURS clauses for insurance amounts and payment history tables
Japanese text in comments (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
EVALUATE MCP-STATUS ALSO MCP-EVENT dispatch pattern
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Signed numeric fields (PIC S9) for adjustment amounts
REPLACING clause in COPY for record aliasing
verdict.notes: Source file is encoded in a Japanese encoding (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comments. Content is clearly identifiable as JMA ORCA system code. Max line length 74 and fixed format confirmed. The program is a screen-handling subprogram called via the ORCA MCP (Medical Care Platform) framework rather than CICS, but classified as online-cics as the closest analog for interactive screen programs.
